extensions.rationale: Industrial-scale hydrogen handling at 30,000-unit deployment scale implies multiple EPA-permitted hydrogen storage/dispensing sites. EPA FRS would index them.

extensions.expected_observable: granted patent count across assignee variants
extensions.signal_direction: corroborates USPTO count or surfaces additional patents under subsidiary names

extensions.claim_text: Plug Power operates manufacturing facilities at 140,000 sqft in Latham NY, 29,200 sqft in Spokane WA, and 38,400 sqft in Clifton Park NY, with service centers in Dayton OH and Romeoville IL.
extensions.source_label: OSHA Form 300A — Plug Power Latham + Spokane + Clifton Park
extensions.rationale: All three NY/WA manufacturing sites are above OSHA's 20-employee threshold; a real 140k sqft HQ+mfg should show up in OSHA Form 300A with hundreds of employees. Absence = scope contradiction.
extensions.expected_observable: establishment list with annual_average_employees and NAICS
extensions.signal_direction: presence at scale = strong corroboration; absence = SEVERE contradiction for a claim of 835 employees

extensions.claim_text: Plug Power operates manufacturing facilities at 140,000 sqft in Latham NY, 29,200 sqft in Spokane WA, and 38,400 sqft in Clifton Park NY, with service centers in Dayton OH and Romeoville IL.
extensions.source_label: BLS QCEW — Albany County NY (Latham) NAICS 3359 / 3364 employment denominator
extensions.rationale: Latham (Albany County NY) is the HQ + main mfg site. PLUG's ~600 NY-resident employees should be a measurable share of county NAICS-3359 (electrical equipment) employment.
extensions.signal_direction: if implied share is implausibly large (>50%) the headcount claim is suspect; if <2% it's normal

extensions.claim_text: Plug Power operates manufacturing facilities at 140,000 sqft in Latham NY, 29,200 sqft in Spokane WA, and 38,400 sqft in Clifton Park NY, with service centers in Dayton OH and Romeoville IL.
extensions.source_label: SAM.gov entity registration — Plug Power UEI lookup
extensions.rationale: SAM lists the federally-registered primary address and NAICS — should match Latham NY and reflect a manufacturing NAICS prefix.
extensions.signal_direction: NAICS mismatch (e.g. SAM lists 541330 'Engineering Services' for a claimed manufacturer) = scope contradiction

extensions.claim_text: Plug Power had 835 employees as of December 31, 2019, including 206 temporary employees.
extensions.source_label: DOL H-1B LCA filings — Plug Power R&D worksites
extensions.rationale: Industrial OEMs with active R&D (33.7M R&D spend in 2019) typically have SOME H-1B engineering hires; very low LCA counts among a 600+ permanent workforce would be unusual. Calibration: traditional industrial co's have lower LCA density than software, so don't over-fire on absence.
extensions.expected_observable: count of certified H-1B LCAs by year and worksite
extensions.signal_direction: presence at scale = corroborates R&D headcount; absence is weak signal (industrial)

extensions.rationale: Plug Power's GenKey installs hydrogen infrastructure AT customer locations (Amazon FCs etc.) — those installations would show up in EPA FRS under either PLUG, the customer, or the gas-supplier (Praxair / Air Products / Linde) as the permitted operator.
